review_checks: Arm-side and glove-side pitch categories use the pitcher, not the batter, as the reference.
Level 4, grade C and 150 km/h thresholds include the named boundary; the source does not mean strictly after it.
Pitching crisis and left-handed-batter modifiers preserve large/small increases and decreases.
CPU batting/pitch-selection preferences remain conditional on CPU control.
Catcher fielding, throw speed, throw accuracy, range, baserunning jumps and Durability remain distinct.
RISP batting outcomes, left-handed matchups, bases-empty hits and first-pitch hits retain separate conditions.
Keep 25/30/40/50 percent probabilities and forced acquisition distinct from meeting a condition.
Hits, runs, earned runs, innings, at-bats and total bases remain different measures.
Keep 3 perfect innings distinct from no hits/no runs, which does not rule out walks.
Acquisition bonuses preserve Presence, Repeat Power and Durability 2/4 prerequisites.
Comeback acquisition requires seventh inning or later; leading off means the first inning.
Fielding Affinity is the full stat term in position-grade requirements; existing compact Fielding labels are retained.
New position acquisition and grade-C affinity improvement both require Spirits.
Planned three-inning relief assignments remain innings 4-6 and 7-9.
The not-close condition is retained in both native descriptions. Late Flame follows the official name without changing the condition.
layout_estimate_scope: Arial 16 px summed glyph advances. Most revised prose is shorter; affinity threshold labels grow to 197 px, and the long new-position requirement shrinks from 554 to 451 px. Actual fit remains pending.
pending: Live ability editor requirements, long condition lines, Fielding Affinity labels and Late Flame badge placement.
Live CPU pull tendency and Late Flame behavior; the static evidence above establishes text association, not executed ability logic.
